services.name: Summer Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Unwind on our Summer Sunset Cruise, a relaxing evening on the beautiful waters surrounding Orcas Island. As the sun sets over the San Juan Islands, enjoy a selection of light appetizers, snacks, and dessert while taking in the spectacular scenery. Complimentary non-alcoholic beverages are included, and beer, wine, cider, and cocktails are available for purchase onboard. It's the perfect way to slow down, soak in the views, and experience a Pacific Northwest sunset from the water. Light snacks & appetizers are provided, but you’re welcome to bring other food & non-alcoholic drinks. Alcoholic drinks must be purchased onbaord. blurb: Guests join narrated whale watching adventures to see orca whales, humpbacks, minke whales, and more around Orcas Island. Tours include complimentary photos, blankets, binoculars, and a restroom onboard. Other offerings include a crab boil cruise and a summer sunset cruise with appetizers and drinks.

quotes.text: Fantastic experience!!!! 10/10! We followed a pod of orcas up into Canada and it was the most beautiful experiance. The Boat Was super clean and comfortable also they give you professional photos at the end, highly recommended!

We had a great outing with deer harbor charters! We saw a group of 8 orcas, eagles nests, and lots of harbor seals! The boat was comfortable and we were given blankets and binoculars to enhance the experience!
Absolutely breathtaking! Super informative with whales in the area. We were lucky to see a few different pods. Very highly recommend and I plan on coming back!
